verdict.rationale: A free self-serve O-1/EB-1 eligibility qualifier is a fair thing to ask of an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows one on the firm's site. The O-1 and startup practice pages describe services and dependent eligibility, not a structured self-assessment. Visalaw AI is a drafting and research tool sold to immigration teams via a free trial, not a founder-facing eligibility check.
